text: What happens when the processing center goes completely silent?
prefix: What happens when the processing center goes completely silent?

text: A debit with no answer is unknown: the money may have moved, so it is never declined, and never sent again.
prefix: A debit with no answer is unknown: the money may have moved, so it is never declined, and never sent again.

text: Someone has to ask the scheme later, and keep asking, even if the app restarts in between.
prefix: Someone has to ask the scheme later, and keep asking, even if the app restarts in between.

text: So each unknown debit gets a Temporal workflow, and Temporal keeps its waits durable.
prefix: So each unknown debit gets a Temporal workflow, and Temporal keeps its waits durable.

text: The workflow only asks for the debit's status, and waits longer each time: one second, then two, four, up to a minute, eight times at most.
prefix: The workflow only asks for the debit's status, and waits longer each time: one second, then two, four, up to a minute, eight times at most.

text: It asks with the same reference the debit carried, our payment id, so the answer is about this debit and nothing else.
prefix: It asks with the same reference the debit carried, our payment id, so the answer is about this debit and nothing else.

text: A Humo hold still waiting is captured as its own step, and only then is the payment paid.
prefix: A Humo hold still waiting is captured as its own step, and only then is the payment paid.

text: Found makes the payment paid, not found makes it declined, and the journal records the answer.
prefix: Found makes the payment paid, not found makes it declined, and the journal records the answer.

text: Not found counts only after the debit call's time limit, because until then the scheme may simply not have it yet.
prefix: Not found counts only after the debit call's time limit, because until then the scheme may simply not have it yet.

text: Found after the buyer's page has closed, the order is over, so the money goes back with a reversal.
prefix: Found after the buyer's page has closed, the order is over, so the money goes back with a reversal.

text: The checks always end before the scheme's next clearing cut-off, less a margin, while a reversal is still possible.
prefix: The checks always end before the scheme's next clearing cut-off, less a margin, while a reversal is still possible.

text: Still no answer, and a person decides: the payment goes to manual review, and the merchant hears nothing yet.
prefix: Still no answer, and a person decides: the payment goes to manual review, and the merchant hears nothing yet.

text: In the bank's console, staff see every payment left without an answer, check it with the scheme, and record debited or not, with a required note.
prefix: In the bank's console, staff see every payment left without an answer, check it with the scheme, and record debited or not, with a required note.

text: Their decision follows the same rule: not debited is declined, debited is paid, or given back if the page has closed, and each one is audited with who made it.
prefix: Their decision follows the same rule: not debited is declined, debited is paid, or given back if the page has closed, and each one is audited with who made it.

text: The workflow's id is the payment's, so starting it twice keeps the first.
prefix: The workflow's id is the payment's, so starting it twice keeps the first.

text: A sweep every minute starts it for anything left unknown, and for debits the app stopped in the middle of.
prefix: A sweep every minute starts it for anything left unknown, and for debits the app stopped in the middle of.

text: If Temporal itself is down, the debit still ends unknown, and the next sweep starts the workflow.
prefix: If Temporal itself is down, the debit still ends unknown, and the next sweep starts the workflow.

text: When the page stops waiting, the payment records that the buyer is owed the result by SMS.
prefix: When the page stops waiting, the payment records that the buyer is owed the result by SMS.

text: The dashboard counts how unknown debits ended.
prefix: The dashboard counts how unknown debits ended.

text: A gauge counts the payments still waiting, unknown or in manual review, and an alert emails when they wait longer than the configured time.
prefix: A gauge counts the payments still waiting, unknown or in manual review, and an alert emails when they wait longer than the configured time.

text: Next, telling the merchant what happened, reliably: the outbox and Kafka.
